Started playing OW in 2018. I deleted this game once during the end of GOATs and very beginning of double shield, then made the mistake of reinstalling it again for OW2 because the alpha actually ended up being fun. Fast forward again a year or so when the team continues to make anti-fun heroes and balance decisions and deleted it again. Reinstalled it on a whim (for the first time via Steam) because of Classic mode and I would play this way forever if I could. High-skill characters are actually rewarding, cheese characters are (mostly) bad, healing is bad/lack of immortality-based cooldowns, tanks can actually be punished for poor play, etc. Alas, I will more than likely end up deleting this once again when Classic mode is gone...

The typical Overwatch experience : you start the game, queue up for a match, decide to play your favourite character. Then get absolutely demolished by the enemy team. Somehow, you convince yourself it's a one-time thing, a bad timing, so you queue up for YET ANOTHER GAME, and get completely obliterated AGAIN. Whether it's out of sheer determination, stubbornness or a mix of both, you decide to ask your duo to join you. Guess what ? You both get utterly destroyed.
Rinse and repeat, that's your daily Overwatch routine.
Every time I go back to this game, it feels just like reconnecting with an old ex I can't let go of. I know it's toxic. I know nothing has changed, but damn, I can't help but return. Overwatch is both wonderful and disastrous, no matter how much you play. And I guess that's what makes it so special, and why everyone finds their way back to it as some point in their life.
Oh, and let's not forget the HILARIOUS moments when your duo starts yelling at you because, well... you suck.

The feeling slowly faded away as time passed and with the situation at Blizzard back in 2020 and Jeff leaving in 2021, Things were not getting better. I tried the game again recently on Steam and it is not the same anymore. It just feels like the design team keeps pumping skins playing on people's emotions making them pay for it. Like the Bumblebee skin or the Pink Mercy and even the latest cat skin for Mercy. That is the only strategy Blizzard is doing to get their cash flow instead of focusing on making the game better.
